description: Signal a running execution to stop, and poll briefly for the terminal state so the reply reflects reality (not a fire-and-forget). Pass EXACTLY one of: `runId` (from tc_run / suite_run), `suiteId` (stops the suite's LATEST execution), or `tcId` (stops the TC's LATEST standalone execution — suite-child rows are excluded). Requires a live connection.

suiteId.description: A suite id (from suite_list) — stops the suite's latest execution.

tcId.description: A test case id — stops the TC's latest STANDALONE execution.

name: run_stop
title: Stop a run
